The Chinese characters for Grant

Origin and meaning

With Scottish origins, Grant is usually read as “great, tall”.

About the name Grant

A Scottish surname name, and the surname of the US president Ulysses S. Grant.

As a gift or a tattoo

Because it means “great, tall”, a Grant calligraphy print makes a thoughtful gift for someone who loves the name or its meaning.
